owner_creation.analysis: metachars: The private pointer starts null and becomes the sole owner of malloc storage holding the selected metacharacter byte set plus NUL.
owner_creation.invariant: A nonnull pointer owns one helper heap allocation.
limitations: Current helper buffers remain raw C-shaped owners; unchecked growth/numeric arithmetic is recorded under M0-MEM-001, without claiming a demonstrated runtime failure.

aliases_escapes.analysis: metachars: strchr and strcpy receive borrowed aliases during direct calls; no external API returns the pointer, but growth retires all aliases of the old allocation.

limitations: Current helper buffers remain raw C-shaped owners; unchecked growth/numeric arithmetic is recorded under M0-MEM-001, without claiming a demonstrated runtime failure.
